checker_coverage_note: The baseline used the earlier checker. C64 used the corrected prepared-prefix branch controls; all policy values/hashes and performance protocol inputs are unchanged. All actual serving settings are identical.
qualitative_user_objective: High completed output-token throughput per GPU before latency rises sharply for little throughput. No numeric latency cap was supplied.
selection_reason: Retain C128 for the primary throughput objective. C64 lowers per-request latency but loses 25.8% of measured completed-token throughput, outside the predeclared similarity heuristic. C64 remains a measured lower-latency option.
limits: One normal window per point; no confidence interval or exact optimum claim.
The native concurrency change also changes the realized replay request mix.
Cache-pressure observations motivated the alternative but do not prove the bottleneck.
The two checker source revisions and their coverage differ as recorded.
Saved-history serving checks under a provisional policy do not qualify RL learning or trainer probability ratios.

gpu_cost.uncertainty: Only the preempted attempt uses a conservative Iris-observed terminal timestamp; queueing is excluded.
